title: Void Flood/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Archimedean Yonta: "The Angels are clawing at the Albrecht Membrane, creating ruptures that will saturate the area with Void."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Enemy activity has enraged the Void Angels. They're ripping the Albrecht Membrane, exposing this entire ship to a Void flood."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Gather up nearby Vitoplast and bring it to the ruptures."
- Archimedean Yonta: "The Angels have torn open another rupture. Fill it with Vitoplast before this whole ship goes topsy-turvy."
- Archimedean Yonta: "I designed this system to deliver Vitoplast directly to Void ruptures. Would've been nice if that design worked in practice."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Vitoplast is everywhere except for where it should be. Grab some and stuff it in a rupture."
- Archimedean Yonta: "For more Vitoplast, trying looking up!"
- Archimedean Yonta: "In retrospect, engineering Vitoplast to float was a mistake."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Collect every bit of Vitoplast you can find."
- Archimedean Yonta: "I think you're carrying enough. Don't you? Bring it to a rupture."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Don't get greedy. Take all that Vitoplast to a rupture."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Don't think you can carry anymore."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Think you got enough for now. Maybe feed it to a rupture."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Oh look, you sealed a rupture. Not bad."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Wow. Vitoplasts sealed that rupture. Just as I knew it would."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Rupture sealed. Onto the next."

path: After Closing Three Ruptures and Thrax Spawns
lines: - Archimedean Yonta: "Void floods have a tendency to wash in terrible things. One of those things is approaching. Do be careful."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Void manifestations coming your way."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Watch out, the rupture has birthed something terrible."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Did you... have a chance to ask it where it came from before you killed it?"
- Archimedean Yonta: "Interesting, they can be destroyed."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Well, that's one less Void abomination to worry about."
- Archimedean Yonta: "I do not know where that thing came from but it will not be going back."
- Archimedean Yonta: "You may notice combat conditions worsening."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Something just changed. Any fighting difficulties to report?"
- Archimedean Yonta: "Void saturation causing further complications."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Should you need a break, self-extract at the marked location."
- Archimedean Yonta: "You can always do more. But if you can't, I have marked an extraction point."
- Archimedean Yonta: "I have opened an escape lift for you. Use it when you need it."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Void saturation is approaching critical levels. Critical levels can kill you. Shall I explain further?"
- Archimedean Yonta: "The Void flood has completely saturated this area. Failure to seal those ruptures immediately will result in, well, total failure. Not good."
- Archimedean Yonta: "You have reached maximum Void saturation. This typically results in death."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Maximum Void saturation. Seal some ruptures or get out of there."

path: Skittergirl Spawn After Straying Away From Objectives
lines: - Archimedean Yonta: "I'm so very sorry about this. One of the fears the Void likes to manifest is childhood anxiety. Meet the repressed fears of teenage Yonta. I call her 'Skittergirl'. She's a thief."
- Archimedean Yonta: "You strayed from your squad and Skittergirl has taken notice. Watch your stuff."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Skittergirl likes to target stragglers. Like you. Right now."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Observation: Skittergirl is stalking you."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Skittergirl you little twit. Get away from them."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Skittergirl stop. Oh, you are insufferable."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Hey Skittergirl stop. They're helping. More than I can say for you."
- Archimedean Yonta: "That should keep Skittergirl away for a bit."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Think you taught Skittergirl a lesson. She never learns."
- Archimedean Yonta: "You lost Skittergirl. Wish I could do the same."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Skittergirl has disappeared back to whatever corner of the Void she emerged from."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Wish I could shake my anxiety as easily as you shook off Skittergirl."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Well, look at you! Saving the Zariman - again."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Not bad for a day's work!"
- Archimedean Yonta: "Ship saved; Enemies overcome; Research notes updated. What more could an Archimedian want?"
- Archimedean Yonta: "Damn the Void. Not another one."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Oh, if we had an ethics board I would definitely get written up for this."
- Archimedean Yonta: "Tenno, are you--? oh dear."
- Archimedean Yonta: "I said get to extraction! Why does no one ever listen to me?"
